input.reply_markdown:
Sorry about the trouble with the screen in Meeting Room 4! Here are a few steps that usually fix a "No signal" message:

1. Check the screen is switched on and set to the right input (HDMI). Most screens have an input button you can press to cycle through inputs (HDMI, DisplayPort, USB-C).
2. Unplug the HDMI cable at both ends and plug it back in firmly. If another cable is available, try that instead.
3. If the laptop connects through a docking station, unplug the dock's power for 30 seconds, plug it back in, then reconnect the laptop.
4. Wake the laptop by pressing a key, then close and reopen the lid.
5. On Windows, press Windows key + Ctrl + Shift + B to reset the graphics driver. On a Mac, unplug and reconnect the display.
6. If you can, check the display refresh rate is set to 60 Hz, as a higher setting can cause issues on older cables.
7. Restart the laptop with the screen connected.

If none of this helps, please let us know the screen's model, whether a dock is involved, and the type of cable used, along with whether the issue also happens on another screen. That will help us dig further.
